capabilities: Search notes by created and modified dates, including ranges and relative periods like last-7d
Find notes that link to or from a note, with wildcard patterns for folders
Filter by words, phrases, tags, paths and file names with a preview line per result
Insert results as a Markdown list and save queries (Pro)
extras: Freemium: OR, NOT, property operators, saved searches and exporting results as a Markdown list require Pro ($15 one-time or $5/month via GitHub Sponsors); sign-in makes network requests to GitHub to verify sponsorship. After updates the plugin opens a promotional 'What's new' tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; it can be turned off in settings. Only Markdown notes are searched; PDFs and canvas files are not.
intentEvidence: It has no operator for the date a note was made or changed, and none for links.
motivation: Two forum requests asked for search operators for note creation/modification date and for links, backlinks and forwardlinks; the author built the plugin to answer them.
problem: Obsidian's core search has no operators for the date a note was created or modified, and none for links, so those queries are not possible there.

relations.evidence: Omnisearch ranks notes by how well their words match
Dataview can list notes by date and by link, but you write each query in a code block

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Search modal with operators for note creation and modification dates, links to and from notes, tags and paths, with a preview line per result.
